deviations.description: Phase 4's Tier Justification names `bash agent-system/extensions/core/scripts/verify-deploy.sh --skip-slow --only-gate 3,4 agent-system/extensions/core` as a passing criterion
deviations.reason: the literal TARGET argument in the plan text (agent-system/extensions/core) is not a repo root and verify-deploy.sh errors on it ('no deploy tree at .../agent-system/extensions/core/.claude'); ran with the repo root as TARGET instead ($(pwd)), which is the argument shape the script's own usage documents. Gate 3 (doc-lint) still reports FAIL, but every FAIL line is 'deployed script content drift' for files this plan's Phases 1-4 touched in the source store and have not yet been redeployed -- exactly the state the plan's own Risk table anticipates ('Phases 1-4 edits... get blocked by the very defect being fixed' / 'redeploy only in Phase 5'). One genuine non-drift issue (Rule R: index-entries.json line_count mismatch for the edited task-reference-exemptions.md, 140 vs 181) was found and fixed via generate-context-line-counts.sh --write before concluding this phase.
